ToneOptions.Label: Strategic Insight
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Adopt a strategic, forward-looking tone emphasizing competitive advantage and long-term market positioning.

ToneOptions.Label: Actionable Intelligence
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Convey an authoritative, data-driven tone focused on actionable insights for immediate decision-making.

ToneOptions.Label: Technical Authority
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Maintain a technically precise and objective tone, highlighting innovation and system capabilities.

ToneOptions.Label: Business Value
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Emphasize a results-oriented tone, connecting technical features to tangible business outcomes and ROI.

GoalOptions.Label: Market Leadership
GoalOptions.Text: Establish the AI-RCA system as the undisputed market leader by showcasing its superior accuracy and speed in incident resolution. The goal is to position the solution as essential for enterprises seeking to minimize downtime and operational costs, driving significant competitive differentiation.

GoalOptions.Label: Revenue Growth
GoalOptions.Text: Drive substantial revenue growth by clearly articulating the system's value proposition to key decision-makers. The aim is to secure new enterprise contracts and expand existing customer deployments by demonstrating a compelling return on investment through reduced MTTR and operational efficiency.

GoalOptions.Label: Product Innovation
GoalOptions.Text: Highlight the advanced AI and data pipeline capabilities that set this RCA solution apart. The goal is to underscore the platform's technical superiority and innovative approach, attracting early adopters and setting new industry benchmarks for incident management.

GoalOptions.Label: Operational Excellence
GoalOptions.Text: Demonstrate how the AI-RCA system enables IT operations teams to achieve unprecedented levels of efficiency and reliability. The objective is to showcase a clear path to reducing Mean Time To Resolution (MTTR), minimizing alert fatigue, and improving overall IT service availability.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Commercial Viability
Criteria: Quantifiable reduction in Mean Time To Resolution (MTTR) across diverse incident types.
Demonstrated ROI through cost savings in incident management and reduced business impact.
Scalability to handle enterprise-level data volumes and complexity.
Clear competitive differentiation against existing manual or less advanced RCA tools.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Technical Performance
Criteria: Accuracy and precision of AI-driven root cause identification.
Ingestion and normalization capabilities for heterogeneous data sources (logs, metrics, traces, alerts).
Performance benchmarks for data processing and AI inference speed.
Robustness and reliability of the data pipeline under high load conditions.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Operational Impact
Criteria: Reduction in manual effort required for incident analysis.
Improvement in alert correlation and noise reduction.
Ease of integration with existing IT Service Management (ITSM) and monitoring tools.
User adoption rates and satisfaction among SREs and operations teams.
